title: Luxury or designer label
when: Few products, strong imagery, the brand matters more than the assortment.
evidence: a pattern from 2 stores: structure only

steps.when: a flat menu of up to 6-8 short items: the categories show on desktop
steps.note: Logo `xl`; with the burger (`centered-logo-burger`, a nested menu) `menuDisplayType` mega or drawer.

variants.when: a nested or long menu that would not fit as links
a short flat menu and a left-aligned look (journal, dense catalog)

steps.when: photography with a quiet zone for the live text
steps.note: Chapter 1: one slide, short light live title.

variants.when: one strong text-free image, full height on phones (journal, premium, dark drop)
the merchant has a short silent loop with its own phone cut

steps.note: Chapter 2, stacked seamlessly under the first (paddings none), linked.

steps.when: journal and premium: one brand phrase set large across the page (kit-custom-sections)
steps.note: The signature block: one block that only this store has, chosen by the look (references/looks.md).

variants.when: journal: a full-bleed photo pair with a corner caption, native
premium and beauty: one real review set large (kit-custom-sections)

steps.note: New arrivals, 4-5 columns; card buttons off (`snippet.enableButton: disabled`).

variants.when: bigger cards for the second source, a change of rhythm

steps.when: a centred form on a neutral band (centred themes)

variants.when: on the footer palette, so the subscription and the footer read as one closing block

steps.when: off-white, grey or cream: soft and premium looks

deviations.home-length: Short by design: 3-4 image chapters carry the page.
deviations.category-entry: Chapters link to collections instead of a tile row.
deviations.hero-stack: Image chapters on purpose: the first chapter after the hero is a full-bleed banner linked to a collection; on phones each is a 4:3 card, so the second screen still shows a way to shop.
